text.content:
Practitioners of this Path revel in luxury instead of degradation. They sate the Beast by glutting its appetite. Although akin to the Path of Typhon in some ways, Ecstatics reject the base cruelties of the Typhonites. Rather than celebrate misery, they glorify pleasure, reveling in the most decadent extremes of vampiric sensation. Members of this path often despise the Kindred of Clan Toreador and take every opportunity to humiliate them.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Allowing someone innocent to survive.
  2. Not wallowing in absolute luxury.
  3. Allowing someone ugly to survive.
  4. Allowing an infector of impurity (i.e., priest, nun, etc.) to live without good reason.
  5. Rejecting wealth unnecessarily.
  6. Not attempting to corrupt an innocent.
  7. Not taking at least one drug regularly.
  8. Restraining your natural impulses unnecessarily.
  9. Failing to accept a gift.
  10. Destroying something of beauty.

Path Traits:

  • Innocence — You always kill mortals that you feed upon. If a victim happens to escape death at your hands during your feeding, you frenzy.
  • Luxury — Frenzy if you happen to lose anything that is yours.
  • Corruption — If you fail to corrupt a chosen target, your anger is without equal; if he cannot be corrupted, he must be destroyed.
  • Addiction — You have become addicted to a foreign substance or drug. If you can't get your "fix" at least once per session, you frenzy.
  • Beauty — The sight of something beautiful being destroyed causes you to instantly frenzy and go looking for the despoiler.
